title: Automated Bias Assessment in AI-Generated Educational Content Using CEAT Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Automated extraction of demographic target and attribute words using a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework, followed by computing association scores via the Contextualized Embedding Association Test (CEAT) which measures the cosine similarities between contextualized word embeddings.
